contract.task_clause:
Which of the following procedures would an auditor most likely complete to test the existence assertion of property, plant and equipment?
Option A: Obtaining a listing of all current-year additions, vouching significant additions to original invoices, and determining that they have been placed in service.
Option B: Obtaining a detailed fixed-asset register and ensuring items are appropriately capitalized.
Option C: Obtaining a listing of current-year additions and verifying that items are recorded in the proper period.
Option D: Obtaining a detailed fixed-asset register and ensuring depreciation methods are applied consistently.
